name: Israel Ministry of Health
description: Government ministry for public health. Its public-health campaigns (e.g. HIV prevention, screening programmes) are produced through the Government Advertising Agency (LAPAM); a 2014 anti-AIDS web film was directed by Doron and Yoav Paz with Tiferet Productions.

relations.note: Production company on the 2014 LAPAM anti-AIDS video
Listed as a client by Cowboy Productions

notes: Ministry campaigns are bought through LAPAM tenders rather than directly. Website kept under links (gov.il) because ingest dedupes by domain and gov.il is shared with other ministries.
description_he: המשרד הממשלתי האחראי על בריאות הציבור. קמפייני בריאות הציבור שלו (למשל מניעת HIV ותוכניות סקר) מופקים דרך לפ"ם, הלשכה הממשלתית לפרסום; סרט רשת נגד איידס מ-2014 בוים על ידי דורון ויואב פז עם תפארת הפקות.
